query: with chosen as(select * from public.works where id in(264,399,2392)) select jsonb_build_object('checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'project','qvplwejffhjvxaypmjut','works',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from chosen t),'authors',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from public.authors t where id in(select author_id from chosen)),'editions',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id) from public.editions t where work_id in(select id from chosen) or isbn_13 in('9789047500445','9789063280918','9789035141704')),'descriptions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by work_id,language),'[]') from public.catalog_work_descriptions t where work_id in(select id from chosen)),'metadata',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by edition_id),'[]') from public.catalog_edition_metadata t where work_id in(select id from chosen))) as preflight;
